findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brand_kit, meta, links, broken_links, sitemap, https_check, headers, status, images, headings, email_security, page_text, forms · Private data: design_tokens, contacts, headings, dns, email_security, forms, company_info, key_pages, crypto_site_check · Public sink: contacts, email_security.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: brand_kit, meta, links, broken_links, sitemap, https_check, headers, status, images, headings, email_security, page_text, forms · Private data: design_tokens, contacts, headings, dns, email_security, forms, company_info, key_pages, crypto_site_check · Public sink: contacts, email_security

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
